{{Quote|The investigators ran a check on all the accounts the bank served and discovered that there'd been a large transfer into Ackbar's account that same morning from the central bank on Palanhi.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
The '''central bank''' was a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] on [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]].

During the [[Thrawn campaign]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] was arrested after [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] technicians made a large transfer of money into Ackbar's account.
